name: The Standard Group Plc

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.source: Operating profit derived two ways that meet exactly on the Standard Group Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2023. FY2023 (633,795) = revenue 2,381,425 plus other income (8,489) less total operating costs 3,006,731, and equally loss before income tax (722,538) less net finance costs (88,743). FY2022 (1,023,464) = 2,743,265 plus (215,676) less 3,551,053, and equally (1,187,826) less (164,362).
